title: Second Largest Element
statement:
Given an array of N integers, find the second largest **distinct** element.

If no second largest distinct element exists (all elements are the same, or N < 2), print -1.
inputFormat:
Line 1: a single integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the second largest distinct element, or -1 if it does not exist.

examples.explanation: All elements are the same, so there is no second largest distinct element.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
